Milton Township Community Mental Health Board

Memorandum of Agreement  
This award of the  Milton Township Community Mental Health Board ("MTCHMB")  is made effective 
as of March  19, 2026, by and between _______________________ ("Awardee"), an Illinois not-for-
proﬁt  corporation , with its principal place of business at ______________________________________ 
and the  MTCMHB, with its principal place of business at 1492 North Main Street, Wheaton, IL 
60187(collectively referred to as "the Parties").   
WHEREAS, Awardee is receiving an Award  in the amount of  ________________ from 
the MTCMHB, which is governed by the Illinois Community Mental Health Act (405 ILCS 20/0.1 et 
seq.) and the  MTCMHB Guidelines for Funding Fiscal Year  2026.   
WHEREAS, the purpose of all  MTCMHB Award is to aid, treat, educate, and prevent mental illness, 
developmental disabilities and substance use/abuse issues for persons and 
families  residing  in Milton Township.   
WHEREAS, to achieve these goals, Awardee agrees to cooperate and collaborate with other 
providers, community groups and  MTCMHB as may be necessary or convenient.   
WHEREAS, the funding provided for  herein  is only for the purposes  set forth in  the Funding 
Application submitted  by Awardee for ﬁscal year  2026  and any modiﬁcations approved by 
the MTCMHB, as are  retained in the official records of the MTCMHB.   
NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the covenants and terms  set forth in  this award, the Parties 
hereby agree as follows:   
1.The  MTCMHB is providing  Awardee with a funding award in the amount of  $ ____________     for
the speciﬁc program set forth in  Awardees’ application, in whole or in part.
2.The Awardee will invoice the MTCMHB in two installments, with  initial  request for 50%
of award invited when both parties have countersigned the agreement, and the second
installment available upon completion of midyear reporting and invoice submission. For  awards of
$20,000 or less, only one invoice will be  required, at the beginning of  grant  term.
3.Awardee midyear and end of year reporting will require documentation to
conclusively  demonstrate  that the expenditures associated with the Award are being used for the
beneﬁt of residents of Milton Township residents. Such documentation shall  state  how ma ny
unique residents of Milton Township have been served by the program, and how such residency is
documented by  Awardee. For awards of $20,000 or less, only one report will be  required, at the
end of  grant  term.DuPage Health Coalition
845 E. Geneva Rd., Carol Stream, IL 60188
$33,600
33,600
4.The  MTCMHB shall have the right to  require  additional  documentation
from  Awardee  throughout the award year  demonstrating  how funds expended were for the
purposes of and in conformance with the Award.
5.The  MTCMHB, in its sole discretion, may terminate or suspend Award payments, in whole or in
part, without penalty,   if the  MTCMHB determines that 1) Awardee has failed to properly establish
that funds were properly expended for the purposes set forth i n the Award, 2) that  Milton Township
residents are not receiving the services identiﬁed in the Award application, or 3) that Award
reduction is necessary or advisable for reasons stated by MTCMHB. Awardee will be notiﬁed in
writing of any reduction or de crease in Award funding, and the  reasons  therefore.
6.By accepting this Award,  Awardee  agrees to provide if/as requested for audit purposes, copies
of all future documented expenditures and/or obligations to the  MTCMHB  in accordance
with  Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).
7.Purchases of equipment or other materials made from this Award by Awardee shall become
the sole responsibility and property of the Awardee.  Awardee  will assume all property control and
custody responsibilities.  Awardee  further agrees that all future costs related to maintenance,
repairs, and upgrades to equipment or  purchased assets made with these Award funds shall be
the sole responsibility of Awardee.
8.Indemniﬁcation and Liability: If any claim is asserted or action or proceeding brought against
the MTCMHB which alleges that all or any part of Awardee's performance under the terms of this
Award caused harm or damage, Awardee shall defend and indemnify t he MTCMHB from any such
claim or action for any costs, including reasonable attorneys' fees, and any compensatory or
punitive damages awarded in connection therewith if it is determined that Awardee has actednegligently in its duties pursuant to this Awar d. Awardee acknowledges that MTCMHB is entitled to
use counsel of  the MTCMHB's  choice, which shall be at Awardee's expense.
9.Insurance: Awardee shall carry all necessary insurance required by law, including but not
limited to Worker's Compensation Insurance to cover all employees who work for Awardee
pursuant to this Award. Further, Awardee shall obtain Commercial General Liabil ity insurance with
a minimum of One Million Dollars ($1,000,000.00) in coverage. Milton Township and the MTCMHB,
including their officers, elected officials, board members, employees, and agents, shall be listed
as additional insureds. Each policy of insurance provided by Awardee shall be primary and not
contributory to any insurance policy purchased by Milton Township or the MTCMHB. The MTCMHBshall be provided with a Certiﬁcate of Insurance prior to the commencement of any work being
performed by Awardee .
10. Merger: This Award shall be  terminated  by the merger or consolidation of the  MTCMHB into
or with any other entity. Notice of such termination shall be provided to  Awardee  in timely  fashion.
11.Independent Parties: This Award shall not  render  the Awardee  a partner, agent of, or joint
venture with the  MTCMHB  for any purpose.
12.Taxes: Awardee shall be responsible för all applicable federal, state, county, local or other
taxes whatsoever designated and whether levied or based upon the compensation paid under this
Award.
13.Successors and Assignment:  All of  the provisions of this Award shall be binding upon
and inure  to the beneﬁt of the Parties hereto and their respective heirs, successors, or assigns.
However, the Awardee shall not assign any of its rights under this Award  or delegate the
performance of any of its duties hereunder, without the prior written consent of the  MTCMHB.
14.Governing Law, Compliance with Law: This Award shall be governed by and construed in
accordance with  the laws of the State of Illinois and the United States of America. The Parties
hereby irrevocable consent to the  jurisdiction  of the state courts  located  in DuPage County,
Illinois, in any action arising out of or relating to this Award and waive any other venue to which
either party might be entitled by domicile or otherwise.
15.Waiver: The waiver by any party of any breach of covenant will not be construed to be a waiver
of any succeeding breach or any other covenant. All waivers must be in writing and signed by the
party  waiving  its rights.
16.Notices: Any and all  notices, demands, or other communications required or desired to be
given hereunder by any party shall be in writing and shall be validly given or made to another partyif personally served, or if deposited in the United States mail, c ertiﬁed, or registered, postage
prepaid, return receipt requested. If such notice or demand is served personally, notice shallbe deemed  constructively made at the time of such personal service. If such notice, demand, or
other communication is given by mail, such notice shall be conclusively  deemed  given ﬁve days
after deposit thereof in the United States mail addressed to the party to whom such notice,demand or other communication is to be given as follows:

17.Modiﬁcation or Amendment: This Award and Memorandum of Agreement may not
be modiﬁed  or amended except in writing signed by each of the Parties to the Award and
Memorandum Agreement18.No Authority to Bind: Neither party shall have the ability to bind the other party with a third
party, nor shall any party  represent to  any third party that it has said authority.
19.Entire Agreement: This Memorandum of Agreement expresses the full and complete
understanding of the Parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior or
contemporaneous proposals, agreements, representations, and understandings, whether writtenor oral, with respect to the subject matter. The Memorandum of Agreement shall be construed as
to its fair meaning and not strictly for or against either Party, including construction against thedrafter. The headings hereof are descriptive o nly and not to be construed in interpreting the
provisions hereof.
20.Unenforceability of Provisions: If any provision of this Memorandum of Agreement, or
any  portion  thereof, is held to be invalid and unenforceable, then the  remainder  of this
Memorandum of Agreement shall nevertheless remain in full force and effect.
21.Counterparts and Right: This Memorandum of Agreement may be signed in counterparts,
which together shall  constitute  one Memorandum of Agreement. The person signing on behalf of
each Party  represents  that he or she has the right and power to  execute  this Me morandum of
Agreement.22.By signing this document,  Awardee  certiﬁes that it agrees to use the Award funds provided
only for the purposes articulated in the application and approved written
modiﬁcations.  Awardee  further certiﬁes and agrees to document and  maintain records
of expenditures  and/or obligations  in accordance with  generally accepted auditing standards.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF the undersigned have executed this Memorandum of Agreement as of the 
day and year ﬁrst written above. The parties hereto agree that facsimile signatures shall be as 
effective as if originals.
